mutelist_note: Copy this file to mutelist.json to use it. Muting suppresses a failing finding; it does not make the gap go away. Every entry needs a justification and an expiry, and sdrscan ignores entries missing either, so a mute is always an auditable decision with an owner and an end date. Muted findings stay visible in every output with their justification attached, and they are excluded from the readiness percentage rather than counted as passes. Set resource_id to a specific rule or indicator, or to * to mute a check across all resources. Never mute a critical finding to get a pipeline green; fix it or drop the certification class.
